card.name: Partway through odd technical strings
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a longer word or string, just before the rest arrives. Examples are kilo-watt, neutro-penia, nano-world, shell flags after mount, and random characters in short web links.

modes.label: Split science words
modes.description: The first piece of a longer technical word, such as kilowatt, neutropenia or nanoworld.

modes.label: Command-line flags
modes.description: The dash after a mount command or option in a shell example.

modes.label: Short web link codes
modes.description: Random-looking characters inside a shortened web address.
